palomar_anchor.current_state: Point-like marks are reproducible beyond a single digitization, but short-duration sky flash versus intrinsic emulsion defect remains unresolved.

retina_anchor.state: Retinal detectors have intrinsic photon-like dark noise and can also be mechanically or particle-stimulated, creating perceived light without an external point source.

bridge_invariant: A detector can emit a localized canonical point response even when the initiating cause is internal to the detector rather than an external point source.

verification_strategy.human_future_event: If an event is noticed while looking at an external scene, synchronized independent imaging at the same time and direction can test whether the event is external to the visual system.
verification_strategy.palomar: Population-level plate statistics, original-material microscopy and future multi-station transient imaging remain the stronger routes.
